author: Parsifal-2045
body:
This PR adds the files containing the new High-Purity models for Inside-Out Muon track selection. A full presentation of the models can be found in the 12/10 Muon POG meeting ([link](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1740450/#37-inside-out-muon-tracking-ov))

This PR needs to be tested and merged with https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52566
title: Add Inside-Out High-Purity selectors
